step: gannenet (40) — /library stopped shipping the corpus to the phone
problem: /library was a client component importing lib/content, so all 180 lessons (3.5 MB of JSON) were bundled into the route. Its only client-side use of that mass was searchTextOf() for the free-text box — paid by every visitor on arrival, whether or not they searched.

bundle.note: Baseline and after taken from `next build` on the same tree; both logs in this folder.

change: lib/search.ts — normalizeSearch/monthOf/isMonthLabel moved out of lib/content.ts so a client component can import them without the corpus. lib/content.ts re-exports them; no caller changed.
lib/content.ts — searchIndex(): lesson id -> searchTextOf(lesson), for the whole corpus. Server-only.
app/api/library-index/route.ts — force-static GET serving that index; prerendered at build time (build output lists it as ○ static).

app/library/page.tsx — now a server component; builds the 180 cards and passes them down. Each card carries `lite` (title/category/domain/month/sub, normalized) so a search has something to match before the index lands.
app/library/library-client.tsx — the interactive half. Fetches /api/library-index once, on the first keystroke, and only then.

verified.build: next build ok, 194 pages (193 before + the new route), 180 /lesson/[id] paths unchanged
verified.index_equals_old_haystack: all 180 entries byte-identical to searchTextOf(lesson) as the page used to compute it — 0 missing, 0 differing (equivalence.mjs)
verified.search_results_identical: 10 terms, same lesson-id set both ways, 0 mismatches (ציפור 12, מנורה 12, בראשית 28, שבת 93, פרשת 55, ריקוד 9, טבע 44, and 3 terms in no lesson -> 0)
verified.not_fetched_until_typed: fresh /library in the browser: 180 cards rendered, 0 requests to library-index; after typing ציפור: exactly 1 request, 12 cards
verified.full_text_still_searched: the ציפור results include cards whose title and blurb do not contain it (e.g. חמשת החושים — מכירים את הגוף) — see library-search-12.png
verified.loading_window_is_honest: with the fetch held open: notice reads מחפש בכותרות בלבד — תוכן כל המערכים נטען… and 1 title match is shown; on resolve the notice clears and the count is 12
verified.filters_unchanged: no filter 180, תשרי 19, תשרי + חגי השנה ומועדים 15, that domain alone 45, גננת משלימה 61; 12 months + all, 10 domains + all — same numbers as the previous step recorded
verified.server_rendered_bonus: the 180 cards are now in the HTML itself (198.7 kB), where before they were painted by JS

untouched.service_worker: public/sw.js needs no change — /api/library-index falls to its network-first-into-shell rule, which is the correct one here: the URL is stable across builds, so a cache-first copy would outlive the content it indexes, and network-first still answers offline from the last copy.
untouched.protected_systems: none touched; nothing here sends or bills

open: /shelf/[id] is 178 kB of route JS (274 kB first load) — the one route still above 120 kB, and the only page a teacher reaches from every file card.
